summary: Implemented Lambda and Lambdad transforms, not committed, tests not run. Changes: Lambda class appended to monai/transforms/utility/array.py; Lambdad class added in monai/transforms/utility/dictionary.py with the internal Lambda, the Callable typing import, and the LambdaD and LambdaDict aliases; docs entries added to docs/source/transforms.rst (Lambda before SplitChannel, Lambdad after ConcatItemsd); new tests/test_lambda.py and tests/test_lambdad.py using NumpyImageTestCase2D with identity and slicing cases plus an alias test. Not covered by tests: non-callable func AssertionError, empty keys ValueError, and whole-application of iterable callables.
